premise: I used my $99,000 widow’s inheritance to co‑found an artisanal birdhouse‑and‑feeder company with my nephew, notarizing a 50/50 partnership and a lifetime of hand‑painted bluebird houses for my garden; after a home‑and‑garden TV feature, a catalog brand offered $510,000 for the designs and inventory, he forged a dissolution, sold everything, and left me a $3,600 ‘starter’ birdhouse; I uncovered our original signed agreement nailed to the underside of a barn‑wood feeder I had built, voided the sale, and now run ‘Wing of Deceit Birdhouses,’ where he drills entry holes in a vest that says ‘Nest of Lies’ and every birdhouse includes a QR code to his fraud conviction.
